summary: EIERSEKSJONSSAMEIET MADLAPARKEN (org. no. 994 799 355) is a condominium (ESEK) based in Stavanger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2010-02-01. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 97.001 (Aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Henriette Kristine Hoff Sandvaag; auditor: TELL NORGE AS.
